uk_going_rate.detail: Standard going rate for veterinarians (SOC 2240), 37.5-hour week, effective 22 July 2025. For longer contracted hours, gross salary must scale up pro rata to clear the hourly rate.

uk_new_entrant_rate.detail: Lower going rate for veterinarians (SOC 2240) — applies to new entrants, effective 22 July 2025

uk_new_entrant_window.detail: Under Skilled Worker Option E, an applicant still qualifies as a new entrant if their Student or Graduate visa expired less than this long before the date of application (also qualifies: under 26, or working towards professional registration/chartered status)

uk_eaeve_deadline.detail: RCVS recognition of EAEVE-accredited EU degrees ends no later than this date, subject to annual review

au_csit.detail: Core Skills Income Threshold for Subclass 482/186 nominations lodged 1 July 2026 – 30 June 2027, indexed annually to AWOTE

us_bcse_fee.detail: ECFVG Basic and Clinical Sciences Examination fee, from January 2026
